research.title: Robustness of Textual Entailment Models to Lexical Shortcuts
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine whether lexical overlap influences entailment predictions across controlled sentence transformations.
Evaluated pretrained classifiers on negation and word order perturbations, separating prediction changes by transformation type and manually reviewing inconsistent cases.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records, checked incoming shipments against packing lists, and flagged discrepancies for review by the operations team.
Prepared order paperwork, organized delivery schedules, and followed up on missing documentation to support routine fulfillment activities.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sentiment Classification Models
bullets: Implemented term frequency–inverse document frequency features with logistic regression and a fine-tuned transformer baseline for review sentiment classification.
Compared classification errors across review lengths and negation patterns using consistent data splits, documenting preprocessing choices and evaluation limitations.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented probabilistic sparse retrieval and sentence embedding similarity to rank candidate answers for a collection of frequently asked questions.
Compared ranking quality using reciprocal rank and recall, then inspected failures involving paraphrases, ambiguous queries, and specialized vocabulary.
